info.title: API.SH: Flightradar24
info.description: The Flightradar24 API from API.SH: public Flightradar24 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An airline's fleet by aircraft type (count and every registration with its model) and its routes (airport pairs with airport names, codes, cities, countries and coordinates, number of flights, distance and average flight time), 25 routes per page with the most flown first, plus its busiest and longest routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-airline

parameters.name: airline
parameters.description: Airline slug from /flightradar24/v1/airlines, or a flightradar24.com/data/airlines link.

parameters.name: routes_page
parameters.description: Page of the route list (25 routes per page; `routes_pages` in the answer gives the number of pages).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every airline in Flightradar24's directory: name, slug (for /flightradar24/v1/airline), IATA and ICAO codes, fleet size and logo; q filters by name or code.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-airlines

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or IATA/ICAO code to filter by.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Flightradar24 airport board, details and weather
get.description:
One airport: name, codes, city, country, position, elevation, time zone, delay index and on-time/delayed/canceled statistics (recent, today, yesterday), runways, current weather (METAR, sky, temperature, wind, visibility, pressure) and aircraft counts, plus one page of its arrivals, departures or aircraft on the ground, each with the full flight fields (status, airline, aircraft, airports, terminal, gate, times). `date` moves the board to another time. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-airport

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: IATA or ICAO airport code, e.g. `JFK` or `KJFK`.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Board: arrivals (default), departures or ground.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Show the board from this time: ISO date or date-time (UTC), or a Unix timestamp, e.g. `2026-11-02T08:00:00Z`. Default: now.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page, from 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Flights per page, 1-100 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One flight by its Flightradar24 id (from flights, airport or live), or the latest tracked flight of a flight number: status, airline, operator, aircraft (type, model, registration, age, serial number, photos), origin and destination with terminal and gate, scheduled, actual and estimated times, flight time and delay, the aircraft's previous flights and the full flown track (position, altitude, ground speed, heading and time of each point, oldest first). Flight ids stay available for past flights.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-flight

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Flight id, e.g. `42435fc4`. Give this or `number`.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Flight number; returns its live flight, else its most recent tracked flight, e.g. `AA100`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

origin.name: New York John F. Kennedy International Airport

get.summary: Flightradar24 flights by flight number or aircraft
get.description:
Recent, live and upcoming flights of one flight number (e.g. AA100) or one aircraft (registration, e.g. G-TTND): flight id, number, callsign, codeshares, status text and type (scheduled, estimated, live, landed, canceled, diverted), airline and operator, aircraft type, model and registration, origin and destination airports (codes, city, country, position, time zone, terminal, gate, baggage belt), scheduled, actual and estimated departure and arrival times, duration and link. With `registration`, `aircraft` adds the aircraft's model, operator and photos. Use a flight `id` with /flightradar24/v1/flight for the track. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-flights

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Flight number (IATA or ICAO), e.g. `AA100` or `BAW729`. Give this or `registration`.

parameters.name: registration
parameters.description: Aircraft registration, e.g. `G-TTND`. Give this or `number`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page, from 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Flights per page, 1-100 (default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Flightradar24 live flights in an area
get.description:
Aircraft tracked right now inside a map area (north,south,west,east), with optional filters for airline, aircraft type, airport, registration, callsign and flight number, in the air or on the ground, and altitude and ground speed ranges; `sort` orders the aircraft returned. Applied filters are echoed in `applied_filters`. Each aircraft: flight id, ICAO 24-bit address, latitude, longitude, heading, altitude (ft), ground speed (kts), vertical speed (ft/min), squawk, aircraft type, registration, origin, destination, flight number, callsign, airline ICAO, on-ground flag, last update time and link. `tracked_worldwide` is the number of aircraft tracked worldwide; `stats` counts them by data source.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-live

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: Map area as north,south,west,east in degrees, e.g. `52.0,51.0,-1.0,1.0` (London).

parameters.name: airline
parameters.description: Airline ICAO codes, comma-separated, e.g. `BAW`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Aircraft type codes, comma-separated, e.g. `A320,B738`.

parameters.name: airport
parameters.description: Flights from or to these airports (IATA), comma-separated, e.g. `LHR`.

parameters.name: registration
parameters.description: Aircraft registrations, comma-separated.

parameters.name: callsign
parameters.description: Callsigns, comma-separated.

parameters.name: flight
parameters.description: Flight numbers, comma-separated.

parameters.name: on_ground
parameters.description: `true`: only aircraft on the ground; `false`: only airborne.

parameters.name: altitude_min
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or above this altitude (feet).

parameters.name: altitude_max
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or below this altitude (feet).

parameters.name: speed_min
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or above this ground speed (knots).

parameters.name: speed_max
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or below this ground speed (knots).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the aircraft returned (default: as tracked).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: With sort: desc (default for altitude, speed and time) or asc (default for callsign, flight_number and registration).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum aircraft, 1-1500 (default 1500).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Flightradar24 flights on a route now
get.description:
Flights tracked right now between two airports (airborne or at the gate): flight number, callsign, aircraft type, registration, position, altitude, speed, heading and link; both_ways=true adds the return direction.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-route

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin airport (IATA).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Destination airport (IATA).

parameters.name: both_ways
parameters.description: true adds flights in the other direction.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: flights tracked now (airborne or at the gate) on this route; scheduled history per flight number is /flightradar24/v1/flights

get.description:
Search Flightradar24 for airports, airlines (operators), flights in the air now, scheduled flight numbers and aircraft. Each result: id, label, name, type, match, codes (IATA/ICAO), position for airports and live flights, flight number, callsign, registration, aircraft type, route and airline logo. `counts` gives the number of matches per type.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightradar24-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Airport, airline, flight number, callsign or registration, e.g. `heathrow`, `BA1`, `G-TTND`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only results of this type.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results, 1-100 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
